description: Scaffold a Playwright test from a description using the project's REAL selectors. Scans the agent's recent file changes (git working tree / last commit, mtime fallback), extracts data-testid / role / label / placeholder / id locators with their source locations, optionally cross-checks them against the live page, writes a ready-to-run spec, and returns next steps. With `steps` it walks the flow on the live page instead: each step must work there, the spec replays them, asserts the URL and aria snapshot where the flow landed, and is run once to prove it passes.

assertScope.description: steps: CSS scope of the end-state aria snapshot (default 'body')

description.description: What the test should cover, e.g. "login with valid credentials"

file.description: Exact spec path (*.spec.ts / *.test.ts) inside the project instead of the default location

liveInspect.description: Verify discovered selectors against the live page (default true when a URL is known)

overwrite.description: Replace an existing spec at the target path (only specs this tool generated)

pageUrl.description: Page the test starts on (default: baseURL from playwright.config)

project.description: steps: Playwright project for the verification run

projectRoot.description: Project directory; defaults to the server working directory

steps.description: Walk the flow: run these steps on the live page first, then write a spec that replays them and asserts the end state

locator.description: Locator or selector, e.g. getByRole('button', { name: 'Next' })

value.description: fill text, press key, select option

storageState.description: steps: signed-in session file, also used by the spec

testDir.description: Directory for the generated spec (default: detected testDir or tests/)

verify.description: steps: run the written spec once to prove it passes (default true)

write.description: Write the file to disk (default true)

name: generate-e2e-test
title: Generate an E2E test
